title: Fix homepage top banner (Header) English title/subtitle translation text

requirements.text: Update the English (en) translation value for `header.title` so the fixed homepage header banner title (rendered by `t('header.title')` in `frontend/src/components/Header.tsx`) displays exactly: "Report by clicking Photo & Get GPS Leader image, Certificate, Complaint & Legal Notice".
acceptanceCriteria: When the selected language is English (`en`) and the user visits the homepage, the large fixed header title text shows exactly: "Report by clicking Photo & Get GPS Leader image, Certificate, Complaint & Legal Notice".
No other user-facing header title text in English shows the old wording (e.g., "Get Leader-Giotag" or "Civic Reporter") in the fixed header banner.

requirements.text: Keep the fixed homepage header banner subtitle text unchanged visually, but update the English (en) translation value for `header.subtitle` so it displays exactly: "Help improve our India by reporting civic issues".
acceptanceCriteria: When the selected language is English (`en`), the fixed header subtitle shows exactly: "Help improve our India by reporting civic issues".
The subtitle remains a single-line truncated subtitle in the header (no layout break/regression from current behavior).

constraints: Frontend files under `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, and `frontend/src/components/ui` must not be edited.
Do not change the backend canister architecture (single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo`).
nonGoals: Do not redesign the header layout, logo, or mode indicator UI beyond the text changes requested.
Do not change non-English translations unless explicitly required.
Do not add new authentication providers or third-party integrations.
